description: Development workflow tooling for Claude Code.

plugins.name: claude-workflow-plugin
plugins.description: An opinionated, stack-agnostic development pipeline: worktree-isolated branches, specialist subagents that write and review in separate contexts, and hooks that make the guardrails enforced rather than advisory. Takes work to ready-for-PR and stops — it never lands on the base branch.
